svg.title: Repairing AGV paths after assignment
svg.desc: EnsureAgvMovePathsClear replays the DAG in topological order; if an AGV reposition is blocked only by another AGV's body, it gates the move on that AGV's next departure.

g.text: DoAgvAssignments orders events by its own serial assignment loop, which can differ from the final topological order. This pass replays the real order, where AGV occupancy is

g.text: exact, and adds one gating edge at a time. Trays and disabled nodes are not fixed here.
